Title: Detection range
Statement: The radar shall detect a 1 m2 target at 100 km with Pd >= 0.9 and Pfa <= 1e-6.

Title: Track update rate
Statement: The radar shall provide a track update rate of at least 1 Hz.

Title: Transmitter peak power
Statement: The transmitter shall deliver peak power of at least 10 kW across 9.0 to 9.5 GHz.

Title: Operating temperature
Statement: The radar shall operate from -40 to +70 degC in accordance with MIL-STD-810H.

Title: Transmit power loss report
Statement: The radar shall report loss of transmit power within 2 seconds.

Title: Track data interface
Statement: The radar shall deliver track data over Ethernet as defined in the ICD.

Title: Weight-on-wheels inhibit
Statement: The radar shall not radiate when weight-on-wheels is asserted.

Title: Radiated emissions
Statement: Radiated emissions shall comply with ARPANSA RPS S-1.

Title: Plot latency
Statement: The signal processor shall deliver plots to the tracker within 100 ms of dwell completion.

Title: Mean time to repair
Statement: The mean time to repair shall not exceed 30 minutes.

Title: Power input
Statement: The radar shall accept 28 V DC power conditioned per MIL-STD-704F.

Title: Receiver noise figure
Statement: The receiver noise figure shall not exceed 3.0 dB.

Title: Antenna gain
Statement: The antenna gain shall be at least 34 dBi.

Title: Transmitter cooling
Statement: The cooling system shall remove 3 kW of transmitter heat at +70 degC ambient.

Title: PSU efficiency
Statement: The power supply efficiency shall be at least 90 percent at rated load.

Title: Track message rate
Statement: The track data interface shall publish track messages at 10 Hz over UDP.

Title: Forward-power monitor
Statement: Built-in test shall detect transmit power loss using a forward-power sensor.

Title: WoW input debounce
Statement: The weight-on-wheels input shall be debounced within 50 ms.
